encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἐν μησὶν ὀλίγοις ὥσπερ ᾠόν τις ῥοφῶν.

div.note: Athenaeus 2, 58a ᾠῶν δὲ ῥοφητῶν μνημονεύει Νικόμαχος κτλ.

1. μοι κ. τοῦ Cobet. V. 1.2 375. 6. N. 1. 614] γὰρ κ. μοι τοῦ CE. 2. συνεστρόγγυλα Mein] συνεστρογγύλικα CE. cf. Cob. V. 1.2 375. cf. Alexid. 246, 4. 2. ἐξεκόκκισα ab Aristophane mutuatus est. Ach. 1179. Pac. 63. Lys. 364. 448. 3. i. e. οὕτω ῥᾳδίως ὥσπερ τις ᾠὸν ῥοφεῖ.

lg.l: ὦ χαῖρε, χρυσοκλύστα καὶ χρυσοῦς ἐμῶν.

div.note: Athenaeus 11, 781f φησὶ πρός τινα Νικόμαχος κτλ. χαῖρε add. Mein. χρυσόκλυστα Letronn. De nom. vas. gr. 56] χρυσοκλαῦστα C. — Midam aliquem adloquitur. cf. Pherecr. 131. Diphil. 43, 21.
Quae Bekker. Anecd. 337, 11 et 349, 10 adferuntur Nicomachi frustula, ea ad tragicum Nicomachum potius pertinere intellexit Meinekius I 498. cf. Nauck. Tr. gr. fr. p. 591.
